summary.intent: Plan Phase 49 (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation), execute it, then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security-review, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and opening a PR, followed by resolving the post-PR CodeRabbit GitHub review.
summary.outcome: Planning prerequisites were completed (research, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md, scope expansion to include batch+drag move) and committed. The transcript ends just before the planner agent was spawned; execution and all PR-QA steps had not yet begun.

repo: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange is fully key-agnostic (takes raw source/dest folder key bytes) and is reusable verbatim for the shared-folder case without modification.
share_keys entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder path — file keys do NOT need re-registration after an intra-share folder move.

adoptSharedFolderResult must be called only once (for the source result); calling it for the dest result would corrupt the sharedFolderTree projection because it emits sharedFolder:updated filtered by shareId.
sdkCore.moveItem throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision — no auto-rename logic needed.
The @internal tag on ensureFolderLoaded is documentation-only; it can be called directly from the web layer without creating a new public alias.
File IPNS re-encryption key must be resolved from share_keys keyType:'file-ipns', NOT from FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted (which is owner-wrapped and unreadable by recipients).

Batch move in private vault is a pure web-layer pattern: useFileBrowserActions selection Set → handleBatchMoveConfirm → useFolderMutations.handleMoveItems — loops single-item client.moveItem with no dedicated SDK batch method.

Drag-and-drop move in private vault lives in FileListItem: handleDragStart (multi-select-aware) → handleDropOnFolder → moveItem/moveItems. Shared side has no selection state and no internal DnD today.

code.finding: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange signature is key-agnostic — accepts raw sourceFolderKey/destFolderKey/fileIpnsPrivateKey bytes, no owner-vs-recipient distinction.
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist currently lists only 7 Phase 48 methods; both moveInSharedFolder and enumerateSharedSubtree must be added.
moveItem throws on name collision; error propagates through runWrite → p.setError. Collision policy is throw, not auto-rename.

workflow: GSD plan-phase chain: research agent → Nyquist VALIDATION.md (from template) → pattern-mapper agent → planner agent → plan-checker revision loop until clean.
CodeRabbit CLI review (coderabbit review --agent) runs BEFORE PR creation; after the PR is opened, CodeRabbit auto-posts a GitHub review that /resolve-pr-reviews addresses.
git config --local commit.gpgsign false disables signing for a session without touching the global config — reverting requires git config --local --unset commit.gpgsign.
If the intel API surface extractor produces empty output, it can be safely omitted from the planner prompt when RESEARCH.md already carries all verified symbol references.
AI-SPEC keyword gate can false-positive on unrelated terms (e.g., 'eval' in e2e requirement text) — requires a manual override decision, not an automatic skip.
Scope expansion should be folded into ROADMAP.md and CONTEXT.md before the planner agent is spawned, not after, to avoid a re-plan cycle.

friction: 1Password git-commit signing would wedge automated GSD commits during AFK sessions — required disabling commit.gpgsign locally before the long unattended run.
AI-SPEC gate false-positived on the keyword 'eval' appearing in an e2e requirement string, producing a spurious gate hit that required manual investigation and override.
Intel API surface extractor produced empty output (regex unpopulated), making it useless as a planner input artifact.
